Hi Lisa — thanks, and quick clarifications from Finance / Tax team: 

- Register Redwood Inference Limited (IE) as the supplier record for EU VAT routing. Use Supplier UID = Redwood-RI-IE-000487 (please map that back to your system).

- For automated PO-invoice matching we require Aurora to populate the PO header field PO_REFERENCE (this is an alphanumeric token of up to 32 characters). If PO_REFERENCE is present on the PO we can auto-link without manual intervention. If not, matching falls back to PO_NUMBER + line-level amounts which increases manual review.

- E-invoice: we can accept Peppol BIS 3.0. Our Peppol endpoint metadata: 
   - AccessPoint: redwood-peppol-prod
   - ReceiverID: 0088:REDWOOD-RI-IE-000487
   - Cert Thumbprint: 3A:7F:5C:... (we'll exchange the full cert via secure SFTP)

- VAT / reverse-charge: if Aurora issues a PO to Redwood Inference Limited and the service is considered B2B, please ensure VAT is zero-rated with reverse-charge indicated in TAX_CATEGORY on the invoice. If Aurora requires a VAT certificate on file, please let us know the upload location; otherwise I've attached our EU VAT certificate for your records.

I'll coordinate the cert transfer separately with your technical AP contact. For the Nov 20 cutover we can run a two-day test window starting Nov 18 for a small batch of test POs.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
